compiled_state.title: Update project docs to reflect bug classification registry, fix-bug Phase G dispatch, and retro integration
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Update skill SKILL.md files, reference docs, and CLAUDE.md pointers to reflect the new bug classification system.
**Why**: The bug-type classifier dispatch is a new mandatory behavior at bug closure. Without documentation in the agent's per-session pointer index (CLAUDE.md) and in the relevant skill files, the invariant is invisible to skills that close bugs without going through fix-bug.
**Scope**:
- IN: plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md (Phase G / classification step documentation); plugins/dso/skills/retro/SKILL.md (bug classification step documentation); CLAUDE.md (architecture pointer to registry + audit/stats scripts; Always Do These entry for mandatory classification; via CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report only — no direct edits); plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md (bug-type-* and bug-type-classifier-failed-* tag conventions)
- OUT: Any new documentation files; CLAUDE.md direct edits (must go through CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, fix-bug SKILL.md Phase G / classification step section documents: mandatory bug-classifier-haiku dispatch, skip condition (Escalated to user: prefix only), byte-exact output validation contract, failure-marker fallback (bug-type-uncategorized + bug-type-classifier-failed-<reason>), MAX_AGENTS exemption, tag-write retry and comment-on-second-failure
  <- Satisfies: doc-router Gate 1 (skill-scoped change: fix-bug SKILL.md)
- When this story is complete, retro SKILL.md documents: mandatory bug-classification step, stats script invocation, config keys (bug_classification.recurrence_threshold, bug_classification.retro_window_days), labeled finding requirements (a/b/c), and positive-confirmation requirement
  <- Satisfies: doc-router Gate 1 (skill-scoped change: retro SKILL.md)
- When this story is complete, ticket-cli-reference.md includes the bug-type-* and bug-type-classifier-failed-* tag naming conventions as first-class tag documentation
  <- Satisfies: doc-router Gate 2 (extends existing reference doc)
- When this story is complete, a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report is produced (not a direct edit) proposing: (a) an Architecture (pointers) entry referencing plugins/dso/docs/bug-classification-registry.md and bug-classification-audit.sh / bug-classification-stats.sh; (b) an Always Do These entry for mandatory bug-type classification at every Fixed: closure pointing to fix-bug SKILL.md classification step; the report is surfaced to the user for approval before any CLAUDE.md edit lands
  <- Satisfies: adversarial finding on CLAUDE.md visibility
- When this story is complete, DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION block is included in the completion report

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.

comments.body:
CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE:

## Architecture (pointers) — proposed addition

> **Bug classification registry** (27-slug, 9-group taxonomy; classifier: `bug-classifier-haiku` agent; audit: `plugins/dso/scripts/bug-classification-audit.sh`; stats: `plugins/dso/scripts/bug-classification-stats.sh`; registry: `plugins/dso/docs/bug-classification-registry.json`): see fix-bug SKILL.md Bug Classification Step and retro SKILL.md Bug Classification (MANDATORY) section.

## Always Do These — proposed addition (after item 14)

> **Before closing a bug with `Fixed:`, run the bug classifier.** Every `Fixed:` closure requires dispatching `bug-classifier-haiku` to apply a `bug-type-<slug>` tag. MANDATORY, MAX_AGENTS exempt. See fix-bug SKILL.md Bug Classification Step. Use `classify-bug-at-closure.sh <ticket-id> "Fixed:"` from non-fix-bug contexts.

STATUS: pending user approval before any direct CLAUDE.md edit
